name: shareable-listener-profiles
changes: Share buttons on customer listener cards and profiles use native sharing with a copy-link fallback.
Listener links open the selected profile after existing-session login, password login, or registration.
Customer asset and service-worker cache version updated to 8.9.26.
Captured Razorpay subscription payments unlock the selected listener immediately even while provider activation status is catching up.
Pending and near-renewal subscriptions are reconciled with Razorpay so first payments, renewals, cancellation and expiry stay in sync.
Cancelling autopay preserves access through the already-paid period and locks it after that period ends.
Administrator full profiles show customer/listener autopay and exclusive-access history, source, renewal state and current access state.
Administrators can reset customer/listener passwords and directly grant or revoke listener-specific exclusive access.
Customer checkout retries short provider delays and clearly distinguishes active autopay from administrator-granted access.
Customer and listener messaging now fit the application viewport while keeping only the people list and message history independently scrollable, with explicit readable message contrast.
notes: Run the normal database initialization during deployment so the safe subscription columns and indexes are added.
Keep the Razorpay webhook URL configured as /api/subscriptions/webhook for renewal and cancellation updates.
The distribution is consolidated to 94 files: legacy root listener duplicates were removed and setup guides were merged into DEPLOYMENT.md.
